title: The Ninth Bell
subtitle: The island heard one bell too many.

map.alt: Illustrated investigation map of the island of Vesperholm

investigators.name: Linnea Berg
investigators.description: A white Northern European woman in her mid-thirties, pale-skinned with ash-blonde hair and gray-green eyes. Linnea specializes in altered records, material traces, and patient reconstruction.
investigators.strength: Sees the physical history of documents and objects; excels at patient, exact comparison.

investigators.name: Erik Halden
investigators.description: A white Northern European man in his late thirties, fair-skinned with dark-blond hair and blue eyes. Erik is experienced with ports, vessels, interviews, and contested timelines.
investigators.strength: Reads operational systems and human pressure; excels at route, access, and timeline reconstruction.
